\begin{example} \end{example}[An ordinary Ricci flow is a Ricci flow with surgery] ↗ def:ricci-flow-with-surgery

For ${\mathcal M}=M_0\times [0,T)$ with product time and vector field, ${\mathcal L}_\chi G=\partial _tg(t)$, so Equation (1) is the ordinary Ricci flow equation. \end{example}

Lemma
[Gluing two Ricci flows along a common time-slice yields a Ricci flow with surgery]
